scope: Review of the 11 supplied studies, plus official repository implementations. Concepts are adapted explicitly; no new empirical superiority is claimed.

sources.title: FAPO: Fully Automated Prompt Optimization of Multi-Step LLM Pipelines
sources.use: Adopt scoped error-driven editing, immutable attempt/outcome logs and fixed scorers. Use cached search cases only; do not port agentic pipeline or validation-driven iteration.

sources.title: HAMLET4Fairness: Enhancing Fairness in AI Pipelines Through Human-Centered AutoML and Argumentation
sources.use: Adopt explicit metric/domain constraints and visible fairness/utility components. Do not claim to implement its ASP argumentation or AutoML pipeline search.

sources.title: Fairness-Aware Test-Time Prompt Tuning
sources.use: The method tunes soft prompts for vision-language models using target/spurious entropy. Requires gradients and a different inference protocol; not directly transplanted into discrete frozen-LLM prompt search.

sources.title: Multi-Objective Scheduling for Large Language Model Inference with Prompt-Level Cost Prediction and SLO Awareness
sources.use: Retain explicit input/output expenditure. Its routing/latency/carbon predictors are a different search space and are not added as unmeasured claims.

sources.title: More Than What Was Chosen: LLM-based Explainable Recommendation Beyond Noisy User Preferences
sources.use: C-APO here means Conflict-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for recommendation. It is not CAPO cost-aware prompt optimization. DPO model training is outside this fixed-model experiment.

sources.title: Fairness Aware Reward Optimization
sources.use: Its proxy-Lagrangian reward-model training and fairness certificates require a trained reward model. They do not transfer to hard-label prompt edits; no certificate is claimed.

sources.title: From Bias to Fairness: Mitigating Popularity Bias in LLM-Based Recommendation Systems via Supervised Fine-Tuning and Direct Preference Optimization
sources.use: Popularity-capped SFT/QLoRA/DPO changes model weights and recommendation labels. Not a compatible direct addition to the current four classification datasets.

sources.title: RosePO: Customized Preference Alignment in LLM-Based Recommendation
sources.use: Pairwise preference construction and uncertainty calibration concern trained recommenders. No direct drop-in implementation for this frozen classifier.

sources.title: Guiding LLM Decision-Making with Fairness Reward Models
sources.use: Relevant to Civil Comments and Bios; requires training a fairness reward model and sampling/scoring multiple reasoning traces. That raises recurring inference cost and changes decoding; retain as a separate future experiment.

sources.title: Rethinking Prompt Optimizers: From Prompt Merits to Optimization
sources.use: Use clarity, precise decision boundaries and compact preservation of task information in edit requests. MePO preference-training itself is not ported.

sources.title: LLM Prompt Duel Optimizer: Efficient Label-Free Prompt Optimization
sources.use: The label-free pairwise judge is unnecessary where gold labels already exist. No LLM judge replaces measured accuracy/fairness.

additional_primary_source.title: Efficient Multi-objective Prompt Optimization via Pure-exploration Bandits
additional_primary_source.use: Motivates careful uncertain comparisons. The new delete-one-block guard is an engineering sensitivity check, not this paper's bandit algorithm or a transfer of its statistical guarantees.

repositories.use: Failure attribution and smallest scoped edits; independently implemented, no copied agent runtime.
This is a reproduction/results/resources repository, not a discrete LLM prompt optimizer. Its README redirects end-to-end HAMLET use to the framework repository.
Maintain three-objective progressive common-basis optimizer structure; reuse published plotting color values, disclose changed variation and stability guard.
